# Gcore Video Streaming

> Gcore Video Streaming is a high-load video streaming PaaS. Scale to 1M+ viewers and beyond

- [Gcore Video Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming.md): Gcore Video Streaming is a high-load video streaming PaaS. Scale to 1M+ viewers and beyond

## Getting started
- [Start working with Gcore Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/start-work.md): Use this guide to start with the right Streaming section for live streaming, VOD upload, environment planning, billing, API access, or troubleshooting.
- [Plan accounts for development and production](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/dev_environment.md): Use one account, separate accounts, or custom plans to set up Streaming development and production workflows for small, medium, and enterprise projects.
- [Demo](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/demo.md): Test Gcore demo players for VOD and live streams across HLS, MPEG-DASH, LL-HLS, and LL-DASH, or copy manifest URLs for custom player integration.

## AI video services
- [AI video services](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/ai-video-service.md): Use AI video services for subtitle generation, translation, and content moderation in Gcore Video Streaming via API or Customer Portal.

## Content moderation
- [Not safe for work (NSFW) detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/nsfw-detection.md): Run NSFW content moderation on MP4 videos via the Customer Portal or REST API, create a task, then poll for results using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.
- [Hard nudity detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/ai-nudity-detection.md): Run hard nudity detection on MP4 videos via the Customer Portal or REST API, create a task, then poll for results using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.
- [Soft nudity detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/soft-nudity-detection.md): Run soft nudity detection on MP4 videos via the Customer Portal or REST API, create a task, then poll for results using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.
- [Sport detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/sport-detection.md): Run sport detection on MP4 videos via the Customer Portal or REST API, create a task, then poll for results using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.

## Generate and translate captions
- [Generate and translate captions](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/ai-for-video/generate-ai-subtitles-and-add-them-to-video.md): Generate video captions using Gcore ASR with Whisper models to transcribe audio in 100+ languages and translate captions via the Customer Portal or API.
- [Generate and translate AI captions](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/generate-ai-subtitles-and-add-them-to-video/generate-captions-in-customer-portal.md): Generate and translate AI captions for videos via Customer Portal or REST API - transcribe audio from new or existing videos using auto_transcribe params or direct AI tasks with Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.

## Billing
- [Overview of Streaming tariffs](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/billing/overview-of-tariffs.md): Configure Gcore Streaming PAYG trial activation, active limits, custom tariff plans, and billing terms.
- [Streaming usage and billing reports](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/billing/usage-and-billing-reports.md): Monitor Gcore Streaming usage reports for AI services, delivery, live stream concurrency, transcoding, and video hosting billing metrics.

## Codecs and protocols
- [Accepted input parameters for live streams and videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streams-and-videos-protocols-and-codecs/input-parameters-and-codecs.md): Review input requirements for live stream ingest and VOD upload in Gcore Streaming, including supported protocols, codecs, and file formats.
- [Output parameters after transcoding: codecs, bitrate, frame rate](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streams-and-videos-protocols-and-codecs/output-parameters-and-codecs.md): Configure HLS MPEG-TS, HLS CMAF, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 for Gcore Streaming with H.264, HEVC, AV1, and VP9 codec support and adaptive bitrate for Live and VOD.
- [RTMP](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp.md): Configure RTMP and RTMPS live stream ingest via Customer Portal or REST API; get push credentials, set a pull source URL, and troubleshoot encoder issues.
- [SRT](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/srt.md): Configure SRT live stream ingest via Customer Portal or REST API; obtain push credentials, set encoder latency, configure passphrase, or set up pull ingest.
- [WebRTC WHIP to HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/webrtc.md): Convert WebRTC WHIP ingest to HLS and MPEG-DASH playback via Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [RTMP vs SRT: protocol comparison](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp-srt.md): Review how RTMP and SRT differ in packet loss handling, jitter, latency, bandwidth limits, and encoder buffering on unstable networks.

## Player
- [Built-in web player](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/customize-appearance-of-the-built-in-player.md): Create, configure, and delete a built-in player via Customer Portal or REST API, including colors, logo, autoplay, and embed options.
- [JS Video Player & SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/player-api-tutorial.md): Install and configure the Gcore JS Video Player SDK to support HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 with plugins, SDK methods, events, and error handling.

## Extra features
- [Video streaming API tutorial](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/api/streaming-platform-api-tutorial.md): Create streams and broadcasts via the Video Streaming API, activate recording, handle status webhooks, and manage the stream lifecycle from setup to deletion.
- [Webhooks on system state changes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/extra-features/get-webhooks-from-the-streaming-platform.md): Configure webhooks for Video Streaming events on live streams, VOD videos, VOD deletions, and restreamings via HTTP POST callbacks to a server-side endpoint.

## Interaction with CDN
- [Get started with CDN for video streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/get-started-streaming-cdn.md): Configure CDN delivery for Video Streaming with automatic caching at 210+ PoPs, adaptive bitrate, and per-minute billing based on content delivered to viewers.
- [Custom CDN resources for Video Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/custom-cdn-resource.md): Create a custom CDN resource for Video Streaming to add geo-blocking, referrer validation, IP access policies, custom domains, and per-GB billing.
- [Protect content with video secure tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/video-secure-token.md): Configure video secure tokens for Gcore Video Streaming to restrict per-user content access using signed expiring URLs with optional IP binding.
- [Generate secure tokens for HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/generate-hls-dash-token.md): Generate MD5-based secure tokens for Gcore Video Streaming HLS and DASH content with optional IP binding, using Python or Go backend code.
- [Generate advanced secure tokens for MP4](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/generate-mp4-token.md): Generate advanced MP4 secure tokens for Gcore Video Streaming with optional download speed limiting and IP binding, using Python or Go.
- [Auto-refresh video secure tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/token-auto-refresh.md): Configure automatic token rotation for video secure tokens to prevent link sharing using short-lived tokens with player-side refresh for HLS and DASH streams.
- [Create a video token API with FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/token-api-fastedge.md): Implement a backend video token signing API using Gcore FastEdge and Rust to generate signed HLS and DASH URLs for player-side token auto-refresh.
- [Add token auto-refresh to a video player](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/player-token-refresh.md): Integrate video secure token auto-refresh into a video player using Gcore Video Player, hls.js, or dash.js for protected HLS and DASH streams.

## Live streaming
- [Live Streaming overview](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/getting-started-with-live-streaming.md): Use Gcore Live Streaming for RTMP, SRT, or WebRTC WHIP ingest with HLS and MPEG-DASH delivery, low-latency modes, trial limits, and interactive tools.

## Manage live streams
- [Create and manage a live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/create-a-live-stream.md): Create and manage live streams via Customer Portal or REST API, configure push or pull ingest, and embed HLS or MPEG-DASH playback.
- [Delete or disable a live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/delete-live-stream.md): Delete or disable live streams via Customer Portal or REST API, including active state behavior and irreversible removal.
- [Live stream screenshots](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/live-stream-screenshots.md): Manage live stream screenshots used as player placeholders and API JPEG previews updated every 10 seconds while a stream is live.
- [Stream metrics](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/view-your-live-stream-metrics.md): Monitor live stream metrics including concurrent viewers, bitrate, FPS, and key frame interval, via the Customer Portal or REST API.

## Broadcasting software
- [FFmpeg](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/ffmpeg.md): Push a live stream to Gcore Video Streaming over RTMP using FFmpeg, get server URL and stream key from the portal, then run FFmpeg with the recommended H.264 encoding settings.
- [GStreamer](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/gstreamer.md): Configure GStreamer pipelines to push a live stream to Gcore Video Streaming over RTMP or SRT, using H.264 and AAC encoding with x264enc and avenc_aac.
- [Larix](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/larix.md): Configure Larix Broadcaster to stream to Gcore Video Streaming over RTMP, using Larix Grove to set camera, video, and audio encoder parameters.
- [Open Broadcaster Software](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/obs.md): Configure OBS to stream to Gcore Video Streaming via RTMP. Enter Server URL and Stream Key, set bitrate and keyframe interval, then start the stream.
- [Instant clips](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/clips.md): Create instant clips from live streams via REST API with configurable duration, start time, and expiration. Retrieve HLS and MP4 URLs using Python SDK or curl.
- [Pause and rewind live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/pause-and-rewind-the-live-streams.md): Configure DVR on live streams to let viewers pause and rewind broadcasts via the Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Low-latency streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/how-low-latency-streaming-works.md): Use LL-HLS and LL-DASH over CMAF to achieve 2 - 5 second live stream latency with Gcore's unified transcoding pipeline and Chunked-Proxy CDN delivery.
- [Configure low-latency playback](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/configure-low-latency-playback.md): Configure encoders and players for stable low-latency streaming; tune FFmpeg ingest, set hls.js and dash.js parameters, and choose target latency by use case.
- [Combine multiple live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/combine-multiple-live-streams.md): Configure Multicamera to combine live streams into one player, set status, reorder streams, and embed the player via the Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Insert an overlay (HTML widgets) in your live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/insert-html-overlays-in-live-streams.md): Configure HTML overlays in live streams via REST API - enable html_overlay on a stream, then create, list, update, and delete overlay widgets.
- [PTS and DTS in RTMP/SRT streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/pts-dts.md): Troubleshoot PTS and DTS timestamp problems in RTMP and SRT ingest; broken timestamps cause frame drops, segment misalignment, and stream rejections.
- [Primary, Backup, and Global Ingest Points for PUSH and PULL](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/primary-backup.md): Configure live stream PUSH and PULL ingest, reset push tokens, and set failover source URIs via the Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Record live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/record-your-live-streams-and-save-them-as-videos.md): Configure automatic or manual recording of live streams via Gcore Customer Portal or REST API, set record type to origin or transcoded, start and stop recording programmatically, and retrieve saved recordings using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Create and configure a restream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/create-and-configure-a-restream-to-social-media.md): Create, update, enable, and delete restreams to broadcast live streams via RTMP, RTMPS, or SRT from the Customer Portal or REST API.
- [WebRTC to HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/webrtc-to-hls-dash.md): Start a WebRTC live stream from a browser in the Customer Portal and use the generated HLS, MPEG-DASH, or player links for playback.

## Q&A and Use cases
- [Streaming FAQs](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/streaming-faq.md): Configure Gcore Video Streaming for live and on-demand delivery with LL-HLS, LL-DASH, HLS MPEG-TS, CMAF, and MP4 protocols; manage transcoding up to Full HD, CDN billing per minute or GB, storage for VOD and recorded streams, and usage estimation via pricing calculator.
- [Configure hot-swapping with AWS Elemental Live and Nimble Streamer](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/case-study-hot-swapping-elemental.md): Configure hot-swapping between primary and backup encoders with cross-pull SRT redundancy, SRT latency tuning, and PTS monitoring in Gcore Video Streaming.
- [Video streaming HTTP status codes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/http-status-codes.md): Check HTTP status codes returned by Gcore Video Streaming for manifests and chunks, including CMAF X-Err-Code values for 404 errors.
- [Live Streaming issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/live-streaming-issues.md): Troubleshoot Live Streaming issues including DVR chunk retention, low-latency HLS buffering, empty manifests, packet loss via SRT, and restream failures by checking encoder settings, bitrate stability, key frame intervals, network latency, and manifest generation.
- [VOD issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/vod-issues.md): Troubleshoot VOD upload failures, transcoding errors, 503 and 404 responses, Error status from inconsistent sources, and high TTFB.

## WebRTC issues
- [Fix the camera or microphone if they do not work](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/fix-the-camera-or-microphone-if-they-do-not-work.md): Troubleshoot crossed-out camera and microphone by allowing site and OS permissions, then testing extensions and the network.
- [Audio quality is reduced when using Bluetooth headsets in video call apps](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/audio-quality-is-reduced-when-using-bluetooth-headsets-in-video-call-apps.md): Troubleshoot Bluetooth call audio drop when a video call opens the headset microphone and the device switches from A2DP to HSP or HFP.

## Statistics
- [Video player metrics](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-built-in-player.md): Monitor built-in Video Hosting player metrics for view duration, geography, browsers, hosts, operating systems, and viewer counts in the Customer Portal.
- [Video views and delivered minutes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-views.md): Monitor unique viewers and delivery minutes for a Video Hosting video on the Statistics tab in the Customer Portal.
- [View statistics of live streams and videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/view-statistics-of-live-streams-videos-and-billing.md): View and query viewer statistics for videos, live streams, and playlists via the Customer Portal or REST API, get view counts, browser breakdowns, and geographic data using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.

## Video hosting
- [Getting started with video hosting](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/getting-started-with-video-hosting.md): Start using Gcore Video Hosting, upload source files, let Gcore transcode and package into HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4, then publish through a hosted player or a third-party player, with optional subtitles, multi-audio, encryption, and viewer analytics.

## Manage library
- [Upload a video and embed it into your app](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-a-video-and-embed-it-to-your-app.md): Upload videos to Gcore Video Hosting via Customer Portal or REST API by creating a video entity from an external URL, polling the processing status, and retrieving HLS, MPEG-DASH, and iframe embed links using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Organize uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/organize-uploaded-videos.md): Organize videos in Gcore Streaming with directories and tags via Customer Portal, or manage directories via REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Delete uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/delete-videos.md): Delete uploaded videos in Gcore Video Hosting via Customer Portal or REST API, permanently removing all transcoded versions, subtitles, and screenshots.
- [Download files](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/original-files.md): Download transcoded video files in multiple codecs and resolutions from Gcore Video Streaming via Customer Portal after original files are deleted post-transcoding.
- [Protect your videos with the AES-128 encryption](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/protect-your-videos-with-the-aes-128-encryption.md): Enable and manage AES-128 encryption per video via the Streaming API and integrate a keyserver to retrieve decryption keys using the Gcore CDN encryption endpoint.
- [HEVC, AV1, and VP9 multi-codec VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-codec.md): Check multi-codec quality presets and access codec-filtered HLS and MPEG-DASH manifests via the Streaming API for HEVC, AV1, and VP9 VOD delivery.
- [HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/hls-and-mp4.md): Retrieve HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 playback URLs for a video via Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Create an illusion of a live broadcast with uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-an-illusion-of-a-live-broadcast-with-uploaded-videos.md): Configure Live imitation in Gcore Video Streaming to broadcast uploaded VOD videos at a scheduled start time using Customer Portal or REST API playlists with start_time, loop, and active parameters, then embed via iframe player code.
- [Videos with multiple audio tracks](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-audio.md): Deploy VOD assets with multiple embedded audio tracks in HLS and DASH manifests, with automatic language metadata extraction, audio codec transcoding across ABR qualities, and player UI language selection for multilingual content distribution.
- [Create and configure playlists for videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-and-configure-playlists-for-videos.md): Create and configure video playlists in Gcore Streaming via Customer Portal by adding videos in the Editor, or via REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl.
- [Video Lifecycle and Statuses](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/vod-status.md): Track video and rendition statuses throughout the VOD lifecycle - empty, uploading, processing, ready, and failed states; renditions transition from transcoding to finished or failed with mp4_url availability and HLS DASH manifest updates via the videos API.
- [Subtitles and closed captions for VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/subtitles-and-closed-captions-for-vod.md): Manage subtitles and closed captions for VOD videos via Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, and curl - add, list, update, and delete WebVTT and SRT timed text tracks.
- [Timeline hover previews: use with players and Roku devices](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/timeline-hover-previews-use-in-players-and-roku-devices.md): Enable timeline hover previews (trick play) in Gcore Streaming Platform using WebVTT format via Get video API with storyboard tiles and VTT coordinates, or embed tiles in HLS .m3u8 manifests for Roku trick play specification compliance.
- [Upload video via API to VOD storage](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-video-via-api.md): Upload videos to Gcore Video Hosting by copying files from external storage or uploading local files with TUS, configure transcoding priority and AI subtitles at creation time, and prepare large batch migrations.
